label: P1: Shared query contract and repository discovery
P2: Session turn message tool and event workflows
instructions: You own the PM composition and canonical task/receipt paths named in the reviewed guide; each worker owns its assigned source/test paths. Read the product ACs, unit read paths/owners, shared contracts and selected proof before implementation.
Your job is exactly ONE approved phase. Run /builder 6 implement --plan "<plan path>"; log discoveries, tagging any Deferred/Noteworthy a human must see before ship.
Done means the phase's acceptance criteria are met, its selected checks actually ran, the composition is verified at its committed SHA, and the execution log links the observed proof.

Before new dispatch, seal committed contracts with harness builder contracts <plan> --seal --review <receipt>, inspect settings and ready, then send a work packet led by owned paths, read paths, job and done conditions. Follow with its actual pointer/digest. Receiving it starts the unit without a separate release. Optional harness builder self-check <packet> --sha256 <digest> gives warning-only root/source/digest orientation and writes no state.

For an already-running worker, dispatch --adopt-peer <id> with the actual --parent and existing --workspace, retaining kind/role controls; current native OMP requires a full clone. Preserve original adopted ownership/authority, sealed source ancestry, progressed HEAD and WIP. Seed only missing metadata; no spawn, reset, replay or new work grant. Existing durable dispatches are inspected/reused, not resent. Native observations are not provider identity attestation.

Import committed deliveries with harness builder compose <plan> --import <deliveries>; it verifies current evidence bindings, actual tree/branch/commit, distinct peers and sealed ancestry, not startup receipts or transport outcomes. The PM wires and commits, then uses --verify <sha>. Guide, coder and PM map deviations remain file/owning_unit/stage warnings for independent review; out-of-map edits need no approval or justification. Real Git, structural and product-check failures remain failures. Import alone is not proof. Preserve historical receipts without replay or reclassification. Solo execution never substitutes for requested independent review.

If every supplied unit is already integrated, compose --import <deliveries> --already-integrated proves frozen map projections equal current committed PM HEAD, falling back to delivery-touched paths only when no concrete mapped paths exist. Empty scope or missing/mismatched evidence is failure. Compare modes/types/Git objects and absence; preserve original worker SHAs without reapplying changes. This is scoped equality, not product proof: compose --verify and independent review still follow. --already-integrated requires --import and conflicts with --verify.

For already-integrated work followed by PM edits, pass --integration-sha <ref> with --import --already-integrated. Resolve a commit between sealed source and current HEAD, compare projections at that point, and retain it as integration_sha without checking it out. Current --verify measures the later PM delta with warnings; do not use detached HEAD or rewrite temporary-checkout receipt roots.

Optional inspection: harness builder on-track <plan> [--unit <id>] [--from <ref>] [--to <ref>] [--untracked]. No readiness, seal, review or receipt prerequisite, no writes, exit 0; show compared, warnings, issues and basis/full SHAs. Default includes tracked staged/unstaged work; --untracked explicitly adds new paths; explicit --to is committed-only. Unit history includes all touched paths, even reverted writes; PM uses endpoint changes. Without --from, PM prefers imported integration, then sealed source, then HEAD; a unit uses sealed source or HEAD. Malformed basis is an issue, not fallback; unavailable comparison returns compared:false.

Advisory maps do not authorize global/deployed changes, unrelated workspaces, changes on main, pushes, PRs, merges or destructive actions. Obtain the user's authorization; keep canonical lifecycle writes with the PM.
Use node_modules/.bin/ddocs to maintain assets/backpressure.dd.json, assertion pressure and AC proven_by links to actual execution-log entries; never mark an unexecuted test as proof.

Mutate task state through the CLI, never an editor: node_modules/.bin/ddocs set "<plan dir>/assets/tasks/phase-N/tasks.dd.json#tasks/tk-XXXX/state" checked (and #done_when/tk-XXXX/dw-XXXX/state for each assertion). The .dd.md sibling is GENERATED — editing it is drift.

Rehearse this node's gate before you try to leave: harness plan validate "<plan dir>/plan.dd.json" --address "<plan dir>/assets/tasks/phase-N/tasks.dd.json#tasks". Gate-terminal states are checked, human-skipped, na; unchecked and blocked hold it.
Spend tokens where they can change the outcome; use `--quiet` for routine flow mutations.
Match model tier to work: chores -> cheap subagent, analysis -> Opus-class, judgement -> lead; context may override (§ Shared conventions).
Environment friction is work, not an apology: fix small things, otherwise `harness observe` it — is this environment working for us? (builder SKILL.md invariant #14)

label: Review: P2
instructions: Review exactly ONE phase's diff against its acceptance criteria — confirm the tests prove behaviour and nothing risky slipped in.
Run /builder 7 review — it inspects the newest assets/reviews/*.md and surfaces a verdict; REQUEST_CHANGES loops back to fix, clean continues to the next phase or post-flight.
Done when the verdict is recorded (one finding line) and either accepted or routed to a fix-loop.

Review the exact composed artifact and current plan/guide basis. Record an independent composition ReviewReceipt with harness builder review <plan> --receipt <path>; unavailable review stays unfulfilled.
Close only criteria proven by observed receipts through node_modules/.bin/ddocs. Whole-plan --complete is not a review-exit gate: closeout work is still future work.

label: Boot check
instructions: Pre-flight seam: confirm the harness is healthy before you start coding this phase.
Run /eng-harness-flow --hook pre-flight --json — a REAL invocation; narrate its envelope verbatim, never fabricate one. A manual `harness boot` (or any prior evidence) never satisfies this seam.
Spend tokens where they can change the outcome; use `--quiet` for routine flow mutations.
Match model tier to work: chores -> cheap subagent, analysis -> Opus-class, judgement -> lead; context may override (§ Shared conventions).

On done, receipt first, status second: harness flow comment --path <flow-path> --node boot-1 --kind validation --source agent --text "verdict:<…> time:<…>" (router missing / envelope noop/UNAVAILABLE → text "decision:unavailable reason:<…> time:<…>" — a completed attempt, not a skip) THEN harness flow status --path <flow-path> --node boot-1 --to done. Mandatory unless the human declines — a decline is: harness flow comment --path <flow-path> --node boot-1 --kind decision --source user --text "<their verbatim words>" THEN harness flow status --path <flow-path> --node boot-1 --to skipped.

label: Observe: P2
instructions: Mid-phase capture: record observations (decisions, gotchas, surprises) AS you code, so they don't evaporate as remembered prose.
Run harness observe "<what>" --kind <kind> — a real capture, never a narrated one, repeated through the phase; it stays due the whole time the cursor sits on this phase.
Spend tokens where they can change the outcome; use `--quiet` for routine flow mutations.
Match model tier to work: chores -> cheap subagent, analysis -> Opus-class, judgement -> lead; context may override (§ Shared conventions).

Terminalize at phase end BEFORE the retro drain, receipt first, status second: harness flow comment --path <flow-path> --node observe-1 --kind validation --source agent --text "captures:<count> pointer:<real capture record> time:<…>" THEN harness flow status --path <flow-path> --node observe-1 --to done — done only after at least one real capture. Human decline instead: harness flow comment --path <flow-path> --node observe-1 --kind decision --source user --text "<their verbatim words>" THEN harness flow status --path <flow-path> --node observe-1 --to skipped.
Environment friction is work, not an apology: fix small things, otherwise `harness observe` it — is this environment working for us? (builder SKILL.md invariant #14)

label: Retro: P2 (drain)
instructions: Post-coding seam: drain this phase's observe buffer into durable retro notes before moving on.
Run /eng-harness-flow --hook post-coding --json — a REAL invocation; narrate its envelope verbatim.

Runs after this phase's observe chore is terminalized (real capture receipt, or human decline). On done, receipt first, status second: harness flow comment --path <flow-path> --node retro-1 --kind validation --source agent --text "verdict:<…> time:<…>" (router missing / envelope noop/UNAVAILABLE → text "decision:unavailable reason:<…> time:<…>" — a completed attempt, not a skip) THEN harness flow status --path <flow-path> --node retro-1 --to done. Mandatory unless the human declines — a decline is: harness flow comment --path <flow-path> --node retro-1 --kind decision --source user --text "<their verbatim words>" THEN harness flow status --path <flow-path> --node retro-1 --to skipped.
